## What and why

## Checks
- [ ] `ruff check src tests` and `pytest -q` pass
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## Unreleased`
- [ ] No songs, lyrics, renders or other media added
- [ ] New command / flag / config key / output? The workflow it serves is described (docs/product-scope.md)
- [ ] New kit asset or style pack? Drawn from scratch (no traced characters, logos or brands), no media files, the kit's
  rules, a gallery tile, and a still of the tile attached here (CONTRIBUTING.md)
